environment.intervalConvention: UTC hour start; preceding-hour radiation, precipitation and snowfall shifted to their covered interval; temperature/wind/cloud are samples at hour start.

roofInputs.name: SSW roof
roofInputs.tiltSource: User explicitly states SSW is 15 degrees; section C-C on page 7 labels 15 degrees.

roofInputs.name: WNW roof
roofInputs.tiltSource: Approximately 38 degrees, estimated from the south elevation on page 3 of the roof drawing. Adopted for simulation following user correction; not a measured pitch.

roofInputs.name: NNE roof
roofInputs.tiltSource: User: opposite SSW roof, same dimensions and 15 degree pitch; bearing derived as (199 + 180) mod 360.

limitations: Local shading and panel snow-cover losses are not modelled. Snowfall and ground snow depth are retained as weather evidence, not automatic panel coverage.
Radiation already includes cloud effects; do not apply cloud cover as another multiplier.
Irradiance is an input to the electrical model; panel temperature, conversion and inverter limits are applied separately. Satellite gaps use recorded ERA5 replacements when available.
Historical actuals are settlement inputs, not dispatch forecasts.

corrections.reason: DST fallback end timestamp overlaps subsequent intervals; boundary corrected to next valid interval start.

prices.aggregation: Duration-weighted hourly average; assumes uniform energy within each hour when applying quarter-hour prices. Negative prices retained. Provider EUR-to-SEK conversion may differ from official settlement.
